```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({"entity": str(entity), "metric": metric, "period": period,
                      "value": float(value), "formula": formula})

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly_rows = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_LY"])

    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(rev_tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(rev_lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    if rev_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if len(ly_rows) > 0 and ly_rows["Revenue_LY"].sum() > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(rev_ly), "sum(Revenue_LY) over rows with LY data")
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY",
            num((ly_rows["Revenue_TW"].sum() - ly_rows["Revenue_LY"].sum()) / ly_rows["Revenue_LY"].sum() * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100 on rows with LY")

    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum()
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum()
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum()
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum()
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(u_tw), "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", num((u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(o_tw), "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", num((o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100")

    top = df.sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for this product")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        sh = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]) else (r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(sh, 1), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if rev_tw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
    if len(top) > 0:
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", 1.0, "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["delta"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    for _, r in d.sort_values("delta", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["delta"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in d.sort_values("delta").head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["delta"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    mat = d[(d["Revenue_LW"] >= 500) & d["WoW_Pct"].notna()]
    for _, r in mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100, Revenue_LW >= 500")
    for _, r in mat.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100, Revenue_LW >= 500")

    y = df.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1), "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("YoY_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["YoY_Pct"], 1), "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    du = df.copy()
    du["udelta"] = du["Units_TW"] - du["Units_LW"]
    r = du.sort_values("udelta", ascending=False).iloc[0]
    add(r["Entity"], "units", "WoW", num(r["udelta"]), "Units_TW - Units_LW")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
